notes: Enhancement: Enhances Pull Request tracking by calculating dynamic lifecycle statuses (OPEN, REQUESTED, RECEIVED, RESOLVED, APPROVED, MERGED/CLOSED) based on real-time pull request activity for accurate Value Stream Map (VSM) visibility. Added new fields for the PR collection.
Upgraded the NPM Wrapper package version to support pod multiplexing feature.
Fixed data mismatch issues for DevOps Control pull request records.
Enhancement: Added teamId and teamspaceId to integration properties
Bug fix: APIs for retrieving pull request comments and event timelines have been re-enabled, restoring functionality for the pull request schedule event in the Control plug-in.
Rebranding: Name of the plugin is changed from Control to DevOps Control.
Initial Release for DevOps Control Plugin
